rationale: The shared Real2Sim plugin core deterministically composes existing FA3 reconstruction, vision, human-motion and DCC-interchange contracts. It does not rank or expand eligible providers, models, devices, actions or DCC targets. Provider/model selection remains with Model Router, resource placement remains with HRB, action authorization remains with UAF/MCP and final DCC mutation remains with FA3-DCC-RT3D-001. Any consumer workflow may separately use the existing Decision Fabric only after deterministic eligibility has already been established.
not_delegated: model or provider eligibility and routing authority
host resource admission placement or leasing
DCC scene and final asset authority

project_radar_review.scope: Shared Real2Sim 3D plugin against existing FA3 Decision Fabric boundaries
project_radar_review.note: The plugin produces a deterministic governed execution plan; it does not choose among otherwise eligible candidates.
